title.zh: 完成繁体中文共用界面本地化

purpose.en: Correct the server-rendered shared header, footer, account, and administrator copy that remained Simplified Chinese after the twenty-two-language rollout.
purpose.zh: 修正 22 种语言上线后，服务器渲染的共用页头、页尾、账户及管理员文案仍残留简体中文的问题。

en: Collect every `interfaceText` English/Chinese pair into both the public dictionaries and the compact server-side interface dictionary.
Polish Traditional Chinese account terminology and shared navigation labels, including 帳戶, 帳號, 主要導覽, and 頁尾導覽.
Keep already-localized runtime values protected so Japanese, Traditional Chinese, and other language strings are not translated a second time.
zh: 把每一组 `interfaceText` 中英文文案同时纳入公共词典与精简服务器端界面词典。
校正繁体中文账户与共用导航术语，包括「帳戶」「帳號」「主要導覽」和「頁尾導覽」。
继续保护运行时已翻译文字，避免日语、繁体中文及其他语言被二次翻译。

en: Traditional Chinese shared shell and every locale that consumes the same server-side interface-key path.
zh: 繁体中文共用界面，以及使用同一服务器端界面词条路径的所有语言。

en: Extend the deterministic dictionary generator with explicit server-interface key collection instead of relying on previously generated keys.
Regenerate all twenty non-base locale dictionaries at the same 2,657-key revision and regenerate the compact server-side dictionary.
Add a regression contract that rejects Simplified Chinese account terminology in the Traditional Chinese server dictionary.
zh: 扩展确定性词典生成器，显式收集服务器端界面词条，不再依赖旧生成文件中的词条。
以相同的 2,657 条词条版本重新生成全部 20 份非基础语言词典及精简服务器端词典。
新增回归测试，禁止繁体中文服务器词典出现简体账户术语。

en: Generate equal-size dictionaries, reject foreign-site and source-code contamination, pass lint, production build, full repository and SmartPay5 contract tests, artifact validation, deployment workflow, production HTTP probes, and representative Traditional Chinese, Japanese, and Urdu browser checks.
zh: 生成词条数量一致的语言词典，排除其他站点及源代码污染，并通过代码规范、生产构建、全仓与 SmartPay5 合约测试、产物校验、部署流程、生产 HTTP 探测，以及繁体中文、日语和乌尔都语代表性浏览器检查。

en: User-authored and live classroom content remains in its authored language; this release localizes static product interface copy only.
No live microphone or camera session is started because realtime media behavior is unchanged.
zh: 用户编写内容与实时课堂内容仍保留原始语言；本次仅本地化产品静态界面文案。
实时音视频行为没有变化，因此本次不启动真实麦克风或摄像头会话。

en: Preserve GreatLoveMeta branding, authored English and Chinese home content, SmartPay5 subscriptions, Clerk identity, classrooms, RealtimeKit, referrals, R2, and independent infrastructure.
No Solidity, ABI, payment rule, database schema, or deployed on-chain contract is changed or redeployed.
zh: 保留 GreatLoveMeta 品牌、人工编写的中英文首页内容、SmartPay5 订阅、Clerk 身份系统、课堂、RealtimeKit、推荐系统、R2 与独立基础设施。
本次不更改或重新部署 Solidity、ABI、付款规则、数据库结构或任何链上合约。
